name: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Bracers

guaranteedRewards.name: Zandalar Madcap's Bracers
tooltip: (3) Set: Decreases the cooldown of Blind by 20 sec.
(5) Set: Decrease the energy cost of Eviscerate and Rupture by 5.

narrative.details:
The madcaps of Zandalar are similar to rogues, but above all else they embrace madness... chaos... the unpredictability of existence.  A terror to behold on the battlefield, they sowed the seeds of confusion and mayhem amongst our enemies in the savage times after the tribes splintered.  We would not be here today without them.

Bring to me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub that I seek, and I will grant you the first of the madcap's prized armors.  Embrace the madness!
narrative.objectives: Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Armsplint.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, adventurer... your accomplishments in Zul'Gurub have earned you the right to call the Zandalar tribe as a friend.  I will see to the disposition of the Paragons; for your effort please accept this reward!
narrative.requestItemsText: Seek the madness from within Zul'Gurub and overshadow it with your own, adventurer!  To do so means success, and success means reward!  Let not the Blood God reign supreme again!
